# WOW Laundry

> WOW Laundry is a tech-driven on-demand laundry, dry-cleaning, and garment care service providing doorstep pickup and delivery across Jalandhar and Phagwara (Punjab, India).

WOW Laundry provides premium, hygienic, and affordable fabric care with high-efficiency commercial equipment, antiseptic wash solutions, steam pressing, and express 24-hour turnaround. Customers can schedule pickups, customize wash preferences, and track orders in real time via the web platform and mobile application.

## Core Services

- [Services & Pricing](https://wowlaundry.in/order): Full catalog of laundry, steam ironing, dry cleaning, and specialized item care.
- [Wash & Fold](https://wowlaundry.in/order): Everyday weight-based hygienic washing and neat folding.
- [Steam Press](https://wowlaundry.in/order): Wrinkle-free temperature-controlled garment steam ironing.
- [Premium Dry Cleaning](https://wowlaundry.in/order): Expert dry cleaning for suits, blazers, sarees, delicate silks, and formal wear.
- [Shoe & Bag Spa](https://wowlaundry.in/order): Detailed stain removal, sole whitening, and material revitalization for sneakers and footwear.
- [Curtains & Blankets](https://wowlaundry.in/order): Deep sanitization and heavy fabric cleaning for winter blankets and home upholstery.

## Service Locations & Branches

- [Shop Branch Selector](https://wowlaundry.in/shop-select): Select between our live processing centers.

- [Customer Sign In](https://wowlaundry.in/login): Login to manage active orders and addresses.

- [Shopping Cart](https://wowlaundry.in/cart): View selected items and schedule pickup time slots.
- [About Us & Operations](https://wowlaundry.in/#about): Overview of our hygienic washing process and state-of-the-art facilities.
- [FAQ & Support](https://wowlaundry.in/#faq): Frequently asked questions about turnaround times, laundry detergents, and pickup policies.
